scientific_integrity: Analytic proofs for all asserted mathematical quantifiers; supplementary symbolic/numerical checker is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Idealized zero-initial linear serial two-stage system with a single rectangular pulse, constant known rates and exact shutoff and peak measurements; not calibrated to field data. General two-pair criterion proves at least one crossing; uniqueness only for explicit rate pairs. Novelty remains provisional pending broader independent literature review.
title: A finite-bloom peak-lag inversion and a unique crossover between two serial toxin responses
